# dsh-wo-github

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
plugin: a GitHub subtab in the Workspace Overview tab, presenting the
curre

nt workspace's repository as if you were on the site. Local first:
commits, diffs, and the README co
me from the workspace's own clone.

Also adds a BRANCH PILL to the composer's left row (beside the persona
picker): the GitHub mark plus

the workspace's checked-out branch, polled
live so agent checkouts update it, with an amber badge c

ounting files
with uncommitted changes. When the worktree is dirty, clicking the pill
opens the GitH

ub tab straight on the Pending pane (clicking again closes
it); clean, it links to the branch's tree

. A bag icon with a count between the pill and the
chevron marks stashed change sets (git stash list

/ stash pop). A chevron
beside the pill opens the branch switcher: switch local branches or create

a new one (which
takes the pending changes with you). Switching with a dirty worktree asks
the GitHu

b Desktop question: leave the changes here (stashed, recoverable
with git stash) or bring them along

(refused atomically by git when they
would conflict on the target).
Hidden outside a git repo; a de
tached HEAD shows the short sha.

A branch header sits above the panes: the checked-out branch with
dirty/stash badges and the same sw

itcher the composer pill has, and the
pane body is keyed by branch so switching branches remounts ev

ery pane
against the new checkout.
Four panes:

- **Overview**: the About card: description, topics, stars/watchers/
forks/issues, language, license

, default branch, homepage, last push
(repo name and branch paint instantly from the git remote and

the
branch pill's cache; fetched fields show skeletons, never a page-wide
loading blank);
the README

renders beneath it (through
dsh-md-view), with
relative links and images resolved against the repo,

silent when absent.
- **Pending**: the GitHub Desktop surface, side by side: the file list and
comm

it box on the left, the selected file's diff on the right, always
visible together. One flat list wh

ere every file carries a three-state
checkbox: check = fully staged, dash = partially staged (click

unstages
the file), empty = nothing staged (click stages all of it), a status dot
(orange modified,

green new, red deleted; tooltip carries the word), and
the staged line counts (+N green, -M red, zer

os hidden). The diff is ONE combined
whole-file view (HEAD vs worktree) rendered through
dsh-diff-vi

ew with
distant regions collapsed into gap rows: one column of checkmarks per
changed line (filled =

already in the index; click to toggle just that
line) and a second column per section (a group of c

ontiguous lines),
left of the line marks, anchored at the section's first changed line and
filled wh

en all its lines are staged; click it to stage or unstage the
whole section. A
file's checkbox stage

s or unstages everything at once. Split/Unified
toggles; the commit box commits exactly what is stag

ed. Never amends,
pushes, or touches history.
- **Stash**: the checked-out branch's stashed changes,

one row per entry
with Pop (restore into the worktree and remove the entry) and Drop
(discard for g

ood); entries from other branches are noted, not listed.
Clicking the branch pill opens this pane wh

en the worktree is clean but
stashes exist (dirty always goes to Pending; clean without stashes also

goes to Pending).
- **History**: the checked-out branch's history, newest first, paginated,
laid ou

t like Pending: commit list on the left, the selected commit's
changed files (with +/− counts) besid

e it, and the selected file's
unified diff with true line numbers in the main area; word-level
highl
ights come from dsh-diff-view when installed.

No git clone and no github.com remote? The tab shows a quiet empty state.
A clone WITHOUT a github.c

om remote (gitlab, local-only git) still gets
README and Commits, with branch and last-commit facts

on the About pane in
place of stars.
## How it fetches
Local first: the host half runs git in the workspace clone:

- Commits come from `git log`, commit diffs from `git show`, the README
from the committed file (`gi

t show HEAD:README.md`). No rate limits,
works offline, works on any git host.
- api.github.com fill

s in what git cannot know (stars, watchers, issues,
topics, license) on the About card, and serves a

s fallback when the
clone cannot answer. The page itself cannot call the API, so the host
proxies it

: unauthenticated access works for public repos; set
`GITHUB_TOKEN` in the harness environment to li

ft the
60-requests-per-hour ceiling.
- API caching: About 5 minutes, commit lists 2 minutes, single

commit
diffs forever (a sha never changes). Local reads are uncached, since git is
fast and the data

is live by definition.
- Rate-limit exhaustion surfaces as a clear message in the tab instead of
a

definition.
- Rate-limit exhaustion surfaces as a clear message in the tab instead of
a broken pane.
## How to install

Requires a DeepSeek Harness checkout and a profile, here `web`. Clone the
dependencies and this plug
in into a plugins folder:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the harness; the GitHub tab appears in Workspace Overview.
## Dependencies
- dsh-workspace-overview hosts the subtab and resolves the workspace's GitHub slug (required; withou

t it the client half stays inactive)
- the `git` binary on PATH (local reads); api.github.com access

is the fallback
- dsh-md-view renders the README pane (optional; without it the raw markdown shows

as text)
- dsh-diff-view provides word highlights and the diff grid stylesheet (optional; patches st
ill render without it)
## Plugins dependent on this
*(none)*
